title: Deploy stamped app to Vercel (app + eve functions), record infrastructure.json
Deploy stamped app on the VM target (docker compose or systemd) as the self-host path
evidence: Dropped, superseded by mold_v1-020: the VM is a LOCAL VERIFICATION target, not a deploy target. provision.py --deploy on target=vm refuses in one sentence, and infra/vm/apps/<app_id>/ is regenerated from state as the app's private-Postgres artifact only. The causes are recorded in infra/vm/README.md (eve API fails off Vercel three ways, the agent sandbox would need the docker socket mounted, and durable-workflow auto-resume needs the Vercel-injected OIDC token) and every fix would mean editing the immutable mold. products.json now lists vercel as the only deploy target for delivered and dover. Reopen this as a mold fork if self-hosting the application ever becomes a requirement.

VM deploy target is web-only: no migrations, no eve API or task-workflow services (provision.py vm branch); either implement or mark the target unsupported
evidence: Marked UNSUPPORTED, with cause. provision.py --deploy on target=vm now refuses in one sentence and ensure_vm_scaffold is gone: infra/vm/apps/<app_id>/ is regenerated from state every run as the app's LOCAL database artifact only. Cause recorded in infra/vm/README.md: eve API fails off Vercel three ways (just-bash not bundled; bootstrap exit 1 'no python3 on PATH in this sandbox image'; docker backend 'bash: line 1: /root/fmt_xlsx.py: Permission denied'), every fix inside the immutable mold; making eve start run here needed /var/run/docker.sock mounted into the customer's agent sandbox (root on the droplet); and durable-workflow auto-resume needs the Vercel-injected OIDC token (resumeBearer() -> {resumed:0}), which means editing app/api/cron/resume-workflows/route.ts and agent/channels/eve.ts. One committed deploy target: vercel.

title: Fresh app secrets: OPS_SECRETS_KEY is minted per app, so connector_secrets restored from another app are undecryptable (clone now clears them; document for non-clone apps)
intake: CLOUDFLARE_* are still listed as user secrets even when inference_provider is vercel_ai_gateway (the SUPABASE_* half of this is fixed)
detail: intake.py:169 sets user_secrets unconditionally, so an app on vercel_ai_gateway declares two Cloudflare names it will never use and provision.py then blocks its deploy on them (it blocks on every name in that list). The provider-dependent half is done: PROVIDER_SECRETS at intake.py:176 now derives SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING only for supabase, DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED for neon and POSTGRES_ADMIN_URL for self_hosted.
acceptance: an app with inference_provider=vercel_ai_gateway declares no CLOUDFLARE_* secret and passes provision.py --check without one

title: Build the load lane's stress harness: molds/mold_v1/testing/load/stress.py (private Postgres, task-workflow build, p50/p95/5xx table)
acceptance: python3 .claude/scripts/lanes.py <app_id> --lane load runs test:task-workflow:stress and prints a p50/p95/5xx table
no host port is published for the database it brings up (docker port is empty)
detail: The load lane declares test:task-workflow:stress but the script does not exist, so the lane reports skipped and no application can reach lanes_passing. The declaration already says what it must do: localpg.py up <app_id>, migrate it, build services/task-workflow in a copy of the mold, run workflow.stress.spec.ts and print the table. Measured once by hand: 186 ops, p95 262 ms, zero 5xx — that run was never reproducible.

title: Load lane's fde:thread-open-perf is skipped: give the app its own FDE_OPS_URL and FDE_OPS_TOKEN (unconfigured it points at LIVE fde-agent)
acceptance: FDE_OPS_URL and FDE_OPS_TOKEN exist for the app's own deployment and the check runs instead of skipping
detail: Without a signed-in identity the script measures nothing and still exits 0, which is why the lane declares it skipped rather than passing. Unconfigured it defaults to the live fde-agent projects, so it must never be run as-is. Names only — the runner never reads the values.

title: claudecode_web_replica still runs as role postgres with BYPASSRLS: re-provision it onto its own database and record datastores.postgres.rls_verified
acceptance: provision.py claudecode_web_replica --verify-rls writes rls_verified with role app_rw, bypassrls false, foreign_rows_readable 0 and cross_org_write 42501
the functional lane's rls row passes: the running build's /api/ops/health no longer says BYPASSRLS
detail: The RLS gate (mold_v1-016) proves app_rw on databases the factory provisions now, but this app was deployed before it: the functional lane's rls row reads `role postgres - WARNING: BYPASSRLS, row-level security is NOT enforced (point DATABASE_URL at app_rw)` against https://claudecode-web-opal.vercel.app on 2026-09-08, and its datastores.json still says provider supabase, rls fail_closed, with no rls_verified block at all. factory.py validate does not catch it only because the app is currently `reverted`, not deployed.

title: Context lane cannot measure org isolation: test:org-isolation is skipped for want of an app_rw DATABASE_URL in the mold's .env.local
acceptance: python3 .claude/scripts/lanes.py <app_id> --lane context runs test:org-isolation instead of skipping it
detail: Run 2026-09-08: the check is skipped, and a skipped check is why the lane can never read pass. As role postgres the check cannot detect a leak at all (BYPASSRLS), so it must run against app_rw — bring the app's private Postgres up (localpg.py up <app_id>) and let provision.py --verify-rls write the file. The runner only ever tests for the NAME.

title: Mold snapshot has no app/preview, so the functional lane's test:cards can never run: refresh mold_v1 from source per MOLD.md
acceptance: molds/mold_v1/codebase/app/preview exists after a refresh per molds/mold_v1/MOLD.md
the functional lane runs test:cards without binding a dev server to 0.0.0.0
detail: tests/cards.spec.ts drives /preview/cards and /preview/stickloop; the routes are absent from this snapshot, so the only browser-level functional coverage in the mold is permanently skipped and the lane cannot reach pass. The lane deliberately does not invoke it as-is: its Playwright webServer would start `npm run dev` on 0.0.0.0:3000 on a box with no firewall.
